reason: The actor in a Log line contains a space. Checking the actor field does not find it — the space is the field separator, so the actor reads as "Sean", which is perfectly valid. The clue comes later: the verb becomes "Zhang", and "created" sits where only key=value or ": text" may appear, so the line does not match the §5.3.3 grammar. An implementation that only extracts the first two fields reports this file as clean.
reader_must: reject or report; MUST NOT silently accept
